sender.en: An unknown woman on a WhatsApp video call, then a fake “police officer” or “YouTube” official

name.en: Sextortion video call: nude call recorded, then fake police demand money

how.en: A video call from an unknown number shows a naked woman for a few seconds and is recorded with your face on screen. Then calls arrive from someone posing as a police officer or a YouTube or social media official who says the video has gone viral or a case is filed. You are told to pay to have the video “deleted” or the case closed, and the demands keep coming. Police do not ask for money to remove videos.

text.en: A video call from an unknown number shows obscene content and is recorded.
A caller posing as police or YouTube says the video will be uploaded or a case filed.
You are told to pay per video to have it removed, quickly.
You are told to keep it secret and not to go to the police.

Caller: I am calling from the Delhi Police cyber cell. A complaint has been filed against you for an obscene video call and the clip is on YouTube. Contact our YouTube officer on this number to remove it, else we will arrest you today.

en: nude woman on whatsapp video call
they recorded my video call and are blackmailing

A “police officer” or “YouTube official” asking for money.
Payment per video and repeated demands.
Don't pay: payments lead to more demands.
Block the numbers and keep screenshots.
Report on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and tell someone you trust.
